units.source_text: 多啼令人心烦。”

en.t: Too much weeping only vexes people.

units.source_text: 二女公子已经完全知道匂亲王与浮舟之事。

en.t: The Second Princess already knew all about Niou no Miya and Ukifune.

units.source_text: 她想：“我的姐姐和妹妹都如此命薄，

en.t: She thought, "Both my elder sister and my younger sister were so ill-fated,

units.source_text: 想是她们易于感伤、思虑太深所致。

en.t: perhaps because they were too easily moved and thought too deeply about things.

units.source_text: 只有我一人不知忧患，

en.t: Only I have lived without knowing sorrow or care,

units.source_text: 大约是因此而能活到今天吧。

en.t: and perhaps that is why I have managed to live until today.

units.source_text: 然亦不知能苟延多久。”

en.t: Yet I still do not know how much longer I can linger on."

units.source_text: 思之不胜伤心。

en.t: Thinking this, she was overcome with grief.

units.source_text: 匂亲王知道她已洞悉情由，

en.t: Niou no Miya knew that she had already seen through the whole affair,

units.source_text: 觉得隐讳也太无情，

en.t: and felt it would be too heartless to keep concealing it,

units.source_text: 便把过去之事略加修饰，

en.t: so he gave the past events a slight polish,

units.source_text: 从头至尾告诉了她。

en.t: and told her the story from beginning to end.

units.source_text: 二女公子说：“你隐瞒我，实甚可恨！”

en.t: The Second Princess said, "You kept it from me. How hateful of you!"

units.source_text: 两人在谈话中时而哭泣，时而嬉笑。

en.t: As the two talked, they sometimes wept and sometimes laughed together.

units.source_text: 因为对方是死者的姐姐，

en.t: Because she was the dead woman's elder sister,

units.source_text: 所以谈话比对别人更为亲切。

en.t: he spoke with her more warmly and intimately than he would have with anyone else.

units.source_text: 那边六条院内，万事大肆铺张。

en.t: Over at the Rokujo estate, everything was being carried out on a grand scale.

units.source_text: 此次为匂亲王疾病举办祈祷，

en.t: This time prayers were being held for Niou no Miya's illness,

units.source_text: 亦纷忙骚扰。

en.t: and the place too was busy and in turmoil.

units.source_text: 问病之客甚多。

en.t: There were a great many visitors calling to ask after his condition.

units.source_text: 岳父夕雾左大臣及诸舅兄弟时刻在旁问讯，

en.t: His father-in-law, Yugiri the Minister of the Left, along with his uncles and brothers, were constantly at his side asking after him,

units.source_text: 实在不胜烦乱。

en.t: which was truly more confusion and annoyance than he could bear.

units.source_text: 这二条院里却很安静，

en.t: Here at the Nijo estate, by contrast, it was very quiet,

units.source_text: 匂亲王觉得可爱。

en.t: and Niou no Miya found it dear and charming.
